name: Core SchedulingSnapshot planning input
purpose: Bounded immutable planning input with route position, lot revision, lot-specific equipment eligibility, priority, due date and equipment maintenance state.
authority_level: Core/Twin read-only planning snapshot; no command, approval or execution authority
security_classification: Internal manufacturing planning metadata; no credentials or hidden Simulator Oracle state

semantics.revision: snapshot_revision identifies the immutable bulk view; each lot and equipment entry preserves its current opaque revision.
semantics.freshness: freshness.status is explicit and may be FRESH, DEGRADED or STALE; stale state is not silently usable for high-impact execution.
semantics.eligibility: eligible_equipment_ids is lot-specific qualification/eligibility, not a claim that equipment is currently available.
semantics.authority: read-only planning input; the contract cannot mutate Core, Twin, Simulator or equipment state.
semantics.world: world_id separates primary and counterfactual/simulation contexts; hidden Oracle state is never carried.
